GSEA-Style Enrichment Dot Plot Type

Source: R/type_gsea.R
type_gsea.Rd

Creates publication-ready gene-set enrichment dot plots (GSEA-style) from prerank-style result tables. Terms are ranked along the y-axis, the enrichment score (e.g. NES) on the x-axis, dot size encodes statistical significance (-log10 FDR) and dot color encodes the direction of enrichment. Inspired by cnsplots' gseaplot().

Usage

type_gsea(
  top_term = 20,
  term_col = NULL,
  nes_col = NULL,
  fdr_col = NULL,
  dot_size_range = c(2, 7),
  nes_colors = c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B"),
  show_fdr_legend = TRUE,
  point_alpha = 0.9
)

Arguments

top_term

Maximum number of terms to display (default 20). Terms are ranked by absolute enrichment score, then by FDR.

term_col

Optional name of the term/pathway column. Auto-detected.

nes_col

Optional name of the enrichment-score column. Auto-detected from names like NES, Enrichment Score, ES.

fdr_col

Optional name of the FDR/q-value column. Auto-detected from names like FDR q-val, FDR, qvalue, padj, Adj.P.Value.

dot_size_range

Range of dot sizes (default c(2, 7)).

nes_colors

Diverging colors for negative/zero/positive enrichment (default blue-white-red).

show_fdr_legend

Show the size legend for -log10(FDR) (default TRUE).

point_alpha

Transparency of dots (default 0.9).

Value

A cliplot_type object for use with cliplot.

Details

Expects a data frame with one row per pathway/term and at least an enrichment-score column and an FDR/q-value column. Use the formula interface cliplot(NES ~ Term, data = gsea_res, type = "gsea") or pass the data frame directly. Column names are auto-detected, so results from common tools (fgsea, clusterProfiler, GSEA desktop) work out of the box.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Typical prerank-style GSEA results
cliplot(gsea_res, type = "gsea", theme = "nature")

# Formula interface
cliplot(NES ~ Clean_Term, data = gsea_res, type = "gsea")
} # }
